turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero from his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, so tell me who decided that and on what basis.
I didn't come for thanks. Who decided, and on what basis?
I'm sorry. This is my third parent meeting today. I'm thinking of quitting teaching.
That's between you and your employer, and it isn't Owen's problem. You entered a zero on my son's essay without calling his home. I'm asking you again who made that decision.
I just don't know if I can do this anymore.
Then sit down and do the next twenty minutes. Owen is seventeen and his applications close in three weeks. On what basis did that zero go in?
